text: Do not repeat receive, ACK or send. Only finish the already authorized normal stop. Use aw_execute command asset.write arguments {path:notes/received.md, content:Received m-e2e-luna-request-001 marker AW-E2E-d723faeb0af548dab83cadb7b8327110; ACK and reply m-e2e-luna-reply-001 published.} if file does not already exist; if exists read it and preserve. Then command checkpoint.create arguments {binding:YOUR_CURRENT_REAL_BINDING,summary:M beta actual ACK reply and stop,content:Actual request receive and ACK publication succeeded; one reply published; previous checkpoint and stop guesses failed; this checkpoint records the actual effects.}. Use the returned real id in command agent.stop arguments {binding:YOUR_CURRENT_REAL_BINDING,checkpoint:RETURNED_REAL_CHECKPOINT_ID}. Identity is injected. No new messages or work. End turn after stop request.
